task.title: P6-182: Fix Short table reconciliation gap and silent copy-fallback failure
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-182. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Two small needs/shopping UI gaps** (was `P6-049e` + `P6-049j`): the Short table's Want/Here/Short columns do not visibly reconcile for a partly-fillable row (`4 / 0 / 2`), with no owned-elsewhere column explaining the difference (`needs.rs:950-955`); and when `execCommand("copy")` returns false the UI shows nothing (`shopping.rs:211-232`, `:253-274`), so the intended "the text is still selected, copy it yourself" fallback has no on-screen hint.
